description: "The Boy Travellers in Australasia" by Thomas Wallace Knox is a travelogue written in the late 19th century. The narrative follows two youths, Frank Bassett and Fred Bronson, who embark on an adventurous journey across the Pacific, exploring various islands and territories, including the Sandwich Islands, New Zealand, and parts of Australia.
